description: This source file defines the ArtifactClient class used to interact with the AWS Artifact service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies method signatures for various AWS Artifact operations, including synchronous and asynchronous versions, and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: ArtifactClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Artifact service, providing methods for obtaining account settings, reports, and agreements.

methods.name: getAccountSettings
methods.description: Retrieves account settings from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getAccountSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves account settings from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches a report from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a report from AWS Artifact.

methods.name: getReportMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a specific report.

methods.name: getReportMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metadata about a report.

methods.name: getTermForReport
methods.description: Gets terms associated with a report.

methods.name: getTermForReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets terms for a report.
